body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on ('CES 2013') - Animation contents production company, 'Hisshow' unveiled its 3D bible animation so called 'Hisshow Bible' at the world's largest consumer electronics exhibition 'CES 2013'.

Jesus and the main character Juni' make an appearance in 'Hisshow Bible' . This animation has concept of 'Let's play with Bible!' for kids at 5 to 8 ages. Also it is made with animation, chant, sticker book and dance routine to face bible entertaining like Pororo animation does. 'Hisshow bible' consist of 26 chapters with home and church edition.

'Hisshow' has similar format with variety show that 'Hispop' musician sings with a traditional musical instrument of Hawaii 'ukulele' , so it gives kids no tedious or boring moment. Characters in this animation is made based on musicians took a part in.
Home edition is produced to learn christian education for anyone, and has advantages of understanding and memorizing quotations from bible easily with dance routine and rapping.

For church edition , it added different entertaining materials. It provides worship program for kids' to be focused and give values that worship service is pleasant things to do. 'Hisshow Bible' stimulates kids' curiosity with various characters in animation.

'Hisshow' unveiled smart contents version of 'Hisshow Bible Smart' at CES 2013. 'Hisshow Bible Smart' contains animation, books and smart contents. Also it is made to review or study smart contents in the open air. It is available at App Store and Google play.

In this exhibition, Sam Lee, the team leader of 'Hisshow' said " We participated in CES to identify Christian DVD market and to meet buyers interested in bible. we will participate in CPC CONFERENCE after CES 2013 exhibition and plan to crack the overseas market as well.
